svg.title: A connector outline in silkscreen, with the overhang past the board edge
svg.desc: Drawn to scale, plan view of a connector footprint at the edge of a board, twice. The board has a ground pour, four surface-mount pads at the back of the connector with traces running into the board, and two plated mounting holes. Left, marked wrong: the connector's silkscreen outline stops at the board edge, so nothing shows that the connector hangs 3 mm past it. Right, marked right: the outline continues 3 mm past the edge, over the area outside the board, as if silkscreen could print there.

g.text: Silkscreen stops at the board edge
The fab trims it, but sees the overhang first
Drawn to scale. Dimensions in mm.
Example connector: 9 mm wide, 6 mm deep on the board, 3 mm past the edge.
